name: io.github.Hawaii-Conditions-Prime/hawaii-conditions
title: Hawaii Conditions MCP Server
description: Real-time surf, weather, trail status, volcano, ocean safety, and restaurants for Hawaii.

x402.description: Paid tools accept on-chain USDC via x402. Send a 402-challenged request, then resend with an X-PAYMENT header. No account required.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check — returns server status. Free.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Create a prepaid account. Returns api_key (mcp_live_…). Store it immediately — shown only once. Free.

agent_id.description: Optional unique identifier for this agent

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Returns current balance, original load amount, and low-balance flag. Free.

api_key.description: Optional api key. Prefer X-MCP-Account header.

tools.name: create_wallet_setup
tools.description: Initialise Stripe SetupIntent — returns client_secret for saving a card. Free.

tools.name: save_payment_method
tools.description: Attach a Stripe payment method (pm_…) to your account for autonomous top-ups. Free.

tools.name: link_stripe_customer
tools.description: Link an existing Stripe customer ID (cus_…) to your account. Free.

tools.name: recent_transactions
tools.description: View recent credits and debits (default 20, max 50). Free.

api_key.description: Optional api key. Prefer X-MCP-Account header.

tools.name: add_funds_5
tools.description: Charge your saved card $5 — balance credited after Stripe confirmation. Free to call.

tools.name: add_funds_10
tools.description: Charge your saved card $10 — balance credited after Stripe confirmation. Free to call.

tools.name: add_funds_20
tools.description: Charge your saved card $20 — balance credited after Stripe confirmation. Free to call.

tools.name: get_sun_times
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, and daylight duration by island (HST). Free.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

tools.name: get_moon_phase
tools.description: Moon phase, illumination %, moonrise/moonset, days to next full/new moon. Free.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: 5-day forecast, UV index, wind, sunrise/sunset by island. Cost: $0.10.

tools.name: get_surf_conditions
tools.description: Wave height, period, direction + 3-day surf forecast by island. Cost: $0.10.

tools.name: get_trail_status
tools.description: NPS alerts and state trail closures by island. Cost: $0.25.

tools.name: get_volcano_status
tools.description: Live Kīlauea status from USGS HVO. Cost: $0.25.

tools.name: get_ocean_safety
tools.description: Box jellyfish, rip currents, NOAA marine alerts by island. Cost: $0.50.

tools.name: get_full_briefing
tools.description: Weather, surf, trails, volcano, ocean safety combined — best value. Cost: $2.00.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Find restaurants by location, cuisine, price range, open-now filter. Cost: $0.25.

location.description: Location to search (e.g. Waikiki, Kailua, Lahaina)

tools.name: get_restaurant_details
tools.description: Full hours, reviews, photos for a restaurant by place_id. Cost: $0.15.
